news.title: Malolos Responders Complete Advanced Rope and High-Angle Rescue Training
news.summary: Malolos responders completed four days of hands-on training in rope systems, safety procedures, and high-angle rescue, strengthening coordination among the CDRRMO, barangays, BFP, and PNP for difficult emergency operations.

news.title: Malolos Begins Rice Assistance for Vulnerable Families
news.summary: The city began distributing 10-kilogram rice packs to indigent Maloleños, with 19,125 packs allocated through November. The program supports food security while sourcing rice directly from local farmers.
news.source: Read on City Government of Malolos

news.title: Tara, Basa! Brings Reading Support to 13,188 Young Learners
news.summary: Malolos launched Tara, Basa! with 1,319 Bulacan State University students tutoring 13,188 incoming Grade 2 learners. The program also provides parent sessions and cash-for-work support for participating low-income college students and families.
